title: Unit 5 (Part 2): Theories of Ethnicity & Multiculturalism
content:
ሰላም! ሰላም! የEthioFresh ቤተሰቦች! ✋✨
እንኳን ወደ Social Anthropology Unit 5 (Part 2) ትምህርታችን በሰላም መጣችሁ! በባለፈው ክፍላችን ስለ Ethnicity እና Ethnic Identity መሰረታዊ ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦች ተነጋግረናል:: ዛሬ ደግሞ ለፈተና በጣም ወሳኝ እና ጥልቅ የሆኑትን Theories of Ethnicity (Primordialism, Instrumentalism, Constructivism) እና Multiculturalism (Melting Pot & Salad Bowl Theories) በስፋትና በዝርዝር እንመረምራለን:: ዘና ብላችሁ፣ ማስታወሻችሁን ይዛችሁ ተከታተሉን! 😊💡


1. THEORIES OF ETHNICITY: PRIMORDIALISM, INSTRUMENTALISM AND SOCIAL CONSTRUCTIVISM (SECTION 5.4)

Since the middle of the 20th century, a perennial and argumentative debate about the nature of ethnicity and ethnic identity has taken place. This argument gave rise to a range of theoretical controversies about the capacity of humans to intervene in their own lives—to determine or to be determined. Out of this debate, three major theoretical perspectives emerged: Primordialism, Instrumentalism, and Social Constructivism. Over the past 20 years, anthropology has shifted from cultural evolution theories to structural-functionalist, conflict, and postmodern theories. Modernity and globalization have undermined traditional ways of defining identity, causing "the past to be stripped away, places to lose significance, and community to lose its hold," resulting in identity fragmentation.

👉 ከ20ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን እኩሌታ ጀምሮ በምሁራን መካከል ስለ ብሔረሰብ (Ethnicity) ተፈጥሮ ጥልቅ ክርክር ሲደረግ ቆይቷል:: ሰዎች የራሳቸውን ማንነት በራሳቸው ይወስናሉ ወይስ በማህበረሰቡ ይወሰናሉ? በሚለው ጥያቄ ዙሪያ 3 ዋና ዋና የንድፈ-ሀሳብ (Theoretical) አቀራረቦች ተፈጥረዋል:: ዘመናዊነት (Modernity) እና ግሎባላይዜሽን የድሮውን የማንነት ብያኔ በመቀየራቸው፣ ማንነት እንዴት እንደሚገነባ ለመረዳት እነዚህ ሶስት ቲዎሪዎች ወሳኝ ናቸው::

💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ላይ የሶስቱን ቲዎሪዎች ልዩነት በ 'Matching' ወይም 'Multiple Choice' መጠየቃቸው አይቀሬ ነው! ከታች ያለውን ሰንጠረዥ በደንብ ያዙት!

PerspectiveCore Description
Primordialist ApproachEthnicity is fixed at birth. Ethnic identification is based on deep, 'primordial' attachments to a group or culture.
Instrumentalist ApproachEthnicity is based on 'historical' and 'symbolic' memory; it is created, used, and exploited by leaders for pragmatic self-interest.
Constructivist ApproachEthnic identity is not something people 'possess' but something they 'construct' in specific social and historical contexts to further their interests.



2. THE PRIMORDIAL MODEL OF ETHNICITY (SECTION 5.4.1)

The Primordialist approach is the oldest in anthropological literature, popular until the mid-1970s. Its roots trace back to German Romantic philosophers like J.G. Herder (1744–1803), who stressed the primacy of emotions and language, arguing that every Volk (people) has its own values, language, and spirit (Volksgeist). Herder emphasized the "atavistic power" of blood and soil (Blut und Boden) binding people together.

Key Scholars & Contributions:
• Clifford Geertz (1973): Systematized the primordial model. He defined ethnicity as a natural phenomenon with foundations in primordial ties deriving from kinship, locality, and culture. These ties are seen by actors as deep, obligatory, and natural, which can be stimulated during nation-building.
• Harold Isaacs (1974): Explained primordial ties as 'basic group identity' assigned at birth, being more fundamental and natural than other social links.
• Anthony D. Smith (1986): Theorized ethnic identification through a 'myth-symbol complex' (myths, memories, values, and symbols). He made two distinct claims: ethnicity is natural and innate (never changes over time) and it is ancient and perennial.

In summary, Primordialism views human society as a conglomeration of distinct social groups where ethnicity is an ascribed, fixed, and unchangeable part of one's identity rooted in biological descent.

👉 የፕራይሞርዲያሊዝም (Primordialism) ዋና ሀሳብ፡
ይህ አቀራረብ እስከ 1970ዎቹ አጋማሽ ድረስ ገዢ የነበረ ጥንታዊ ቲዎሪ ነው:: ዋና መፈክሩ "ብሔረሰብነት በተፈጥሮ/በትውልድ የሚሰጥ እና የማይቀየር (Fixed/Unchangeable) ነገር ነው" የሚል ነው::
• J.G. Herder: የጀርመን ፈላስፋ ሲሆን የደም እና የመሬት/አፈር (Blood and Soil - Blut und Boden) ቁርኝት ሰዎችን እንደሚያስር ተናግሯል::
• Clifford Geertz: ብሔረሰብነት ከተፈጥሮ፣ ከዘመድ አዝማድ (Kinship) እና ከተወለዱበት ቦታ የሚመጣ "የግዴታ ትስስር" (Obligatory tie) ነው ይላል::
• Anthony D. Smith: ብሔር ሁለት ባህሪያት አሉት ይላል፡ 1. Natural & Innate (ተፈጥሯዊና የማይቀየር) 2. Ancient & Perennial (ጥንታዊና ሁልጊዜ የሚኖር)::

😄 ቅምሻ ቀልድ: በፕራይሞርዲያሊስቶች እይታ... ከተወለድክበት ብሔር መውጣት አትችልም! እንደ የደም አይነትህ (Blood Group) አብሮህ የተወለደና የማይቀየር ነው! 😂

💡 Exam Hint: 'Blut und Boden' (Blood and Soil) ወይም 'Volksgeist' የሚሉትን ቃላት ካያችሁ መልሱ ወዲያውኑ 👉 Primordialism (J.G. Herder) ነው!


3. INSTRUMENTALIST (SITUATIONAL) THEORY OF ETHNICITY (SECTION 5.4.2)

The Instrumentalist theory views ethnicity as situationally defined, depending on rational calculations of advantage and stimulated by political mobilization under elite leadership. Here, ethnicity is an instrument of group mobilization for political and economic ends (Banks, 1996). It can be changed, constructed, or manipulated by leaders to gain power, resources, and advantages.

Key Scholars & Contributions:
• Abner Cohen (1974): Placed emphasis on the ethnic group as a collectively organized strategy for protecting economic and political interests. Groups develop basic organizational functions such as distinctiveness/boundaries, communication, authority structure, decision-making, ideology, and socialization.
• Daniel Bell (1975) & Jeffrey Ross (1982): Defined ethnicity as a "group option" where resources are mobilized to pressure the political system to allocate public goods.
• Paul Brass & Ted Gurr: Argued that ethnicity is created in the dynamics of elite competition within boundaries determined by political and economic realities.

In moderate views, ethnic groups have cultural content, but group boundaries depend on pursuit of political advantages and material self-interest. In extreme views, ethnic groups are not true communities but rational and purposive associations.

👉 የኢንስትሩሜንታሊዝም (Instrumentalism) ዋና ሀሳብ፡
ይህ ቲዎሪ ደግሞ ብሔረሰብነትን እንደ አንድ "መሣሪያ" (Tool/Instrument) ነው የሚያየው:: ፖለቲከኞች እና የቡድን መሪዎች (Elites) የራሳቸውን የፖለቲካ ሥልጣን እና የኢኮኖሚ ጥቅም ለማካበት ሲሉ የሰዎችን የብሔር ስሜት ይቀሰቅሳሉ፣ ይጠቀሙበታል:: ብሔረሰብነት ሁኔታዊ (Situational) እና እንደ ጥቅሙ የሚቀያየር ነው ይላል::
• Abner Cohen: ብሔር ማለት የፖለቲካና የኢኮኖሚ ጥቅምን ለማስጠበቅ የተዋቀረ ስትራቴጂ ነው ይላል::
• Daniel Bell & Jeffrey Ross: ብሔረሰብነት ከመንግስት ጥቅም ወይም ሀብት ለመካፈል የሚደረግ የቡድን አማራጭ (Group option) ነው ይላሉ::

💡 Exam Hint: ፈተና ላይ 'Ethnicity as a tool/instrument for political and economic gains' ወይም 'Elite manipulation' የሚል ሀሳብ ከተነሳ መልሱ 👉 Instrumentalism ነው!


4. CONSTRUCTIVIST THEORY OF ETHNICITY (SECTION 5.4.3)

The basic notion in Constructivism is that ethnicity is negotiated and constructed in everyday living. It regards ethnicity as a continuous process ("in the making") driven by demands of everyday survival (feeding, clothing, sending children to school, interacting). This approach takes a subjectivist stance, asserting that agency and social context trigger historical and social factors.

Key Scholars & Contributions:
• Frederik Barth: Leading figure who viewed ethnic identity as an "individualistic strategy" where individuals move from one identity to another to advance personal economic/political interests or minimize losses. Barth asserted that ethnic boundaries are psychological boundaries, making internal ethnic culture and content irrelevant.
• Richard Jenkins (1997): Noted that flow of individuals between ethnic groups makes boundaries permeable and osmotic. Ethnicity is dynamic, changing through time and space, continuously constructed, deconstructed, and reconstructed.

👉 የኮንስትራክቲቪዝም (Constructivism) ዋና ሀሳብ፡
ይህ ቲዎሪ ብሔረሰብነት በየቀኑ በሰዎች ህይወት እና ግንኙነት ውስጥ "የሚገነባ እና የሚቀያየር" (Constructed & Dynamic) ነው ይላል:: ማንነት የማያቋርጥ ሂደት (Process in the making) ነው::
• Frederik Barth: ሰዎች ከሁኔታዎች ጋር ለመላመድ እና ጥቅማቸውን ለማስጠበቅ ከእንድ ማንነት ወደ ሌላ ይሸጋገራሉ ይላል:: ለእሱ ዋናው የብሔሩ ባህል ሳይሆን በሰዎች አእምሮ ውስጥ ያለው ማህበራዊ/ስነ-ልቦናዊ ድንበር (Boundary) ነው::
• Richard Jenkins: የብሔር ድንበሮች ተላላፊ እና የሚሰረጉ (Permeable and osmotic) ናቸው ይላል:: ብሔር ይገነባል (Constructed)፣ ይፈርሳል (Deconstructed)፣ እንደገና ይዋቀራል (Reconstructed)::

😄በኮንስትራክቲቪስቶች እይታ... ማንነትህ እንደ ሕንፃ ነው፤ ዛሬ ትገነባዋለህ፣ ነገ ደግሞ እንደ ሁኔታው አፍርሰህ አዲስ ዲዛይን ታወጣለታለህ! 🏗️😄


5. MULTICULTURALISM: DEFINITION AND THEORIES

Multiculturalism is defined as the way in which a given society engages with cultural diversity. The underlying assumption is that members of very different cultures can coexist peacefully, and society is strengthened by preserving, respecting, and encouraging cultural diversity. Politically, it refers to official policies formulated for the equitable treatment of different cultures.

Key Principles of Multiculturalism:
• Deals with cultural diversity at both national and community levels.
• Presupposes that society benefits from diversity through harmonious coexistence.
• Occurs naturally through immigration or through legislative unification of distinct cultural jurisdictions (e.g., French and English Canada).
• Advocates argue it preserves heritage; opponents argue it threatens social order and leads to chauvinism/discrimination.

👉 መልቲካልቸራሊዝም (Multiculturalism)፡
ተለያዩ ባህሎች፣ ብሔሮች እና ሃይማኖቶች ያላቸው ሰዎች በአንድ ህብረተሰብ ውስጥ በእኩልነት፣ በመከባበር እና በሰላም አብረው የሚኖሩበት ስርዓት ነው:: ህብረተሰብ በባህል ብዝሃነት (Diversity) ይጠናከራል ብሎ ያምናል::


6. THEORIES OF MULTICULTURALISM: MELTING POT VS. SALAD BOWL

A. The Melting Pot Theory
This theory assumes that different immigrant groups will "melt together," leaving behind their individual cultures to become fully assimilated into the predominant society and culture. It is illustrated by the metaphor of a smelting pot where iron and carbon melt to create steel.
• J. Hector St. John de Crevecoeur (1782): Wrote that in America, individuals of all nations are melted into a new race of men.
• Criticism: It reduces diversity into a single entity (monoculture) and forces people to lose traditions through government policy. Example: Nearly 350,000 Indigenous peoples were assimilated into American society under the U.S. Indian Reorganization Act of 1934.

B. The Salad Bowl Theory
A more liberal theory of multiculturalism where a heterogeneous society coexists by retaining the distinctiveness of traditional cultures. Like ingredients in a salad, cultures are brought together while retaining their own distinct flavors rather than mixing into a single homogeneous culture.
• Example: New York City with ethnic communities like "Little India," "Little Odessa," and "Chinatown."
• Criticism: Cultural differences can divide society, leading to chauvinism and discrimination. Robert Putnam (2007) noted that people in salad bowl communities were less likely to vote or volunteer.

👉 ሁለቱ የብዙ-ባህላዊነት ቲዎሪዎች comparison፡

TheoryMetaphor / SymbolCore ConceptKey Example / Criticism
Melting Pot TheorySmelting pot (Iron + Carbon = Steel)Cultures melt together into one single monoculture (Assimilation). Individual cultures are lost.USA assimilation policies; Native Americans forced assimilation (1934 Act).
Salad Bowl TheorySalad Bowl (Tomatoes, Lettuce, Olives remain distinct)Cultures live together while keeping their unique identity/flavor. No forced loss of heritage.New York City (Chinatown, Little India). Criticism: May cause social division.


💡 Exam Hint: 'Assimilate into a monoculture' ከተባለ 👉 Melting Pot! 'Retain distinct cultural flavors while coexisting' ከተባለ 👉 Salad Bowl Theory!


7. THE CHARACTERISTICS & IMPORTANCE OF A MULTICULTURAL SOCIETY

Characteristics:
• People of different races, ethnicities, and nationalities living together.
• Citizens uphold, transfer, cherish, and share distinctive cultural ways of life, languages, art, and traditions.
• Public schools introduce young people to the qualities and advantages of cultural diversity in textbooks.

Importance of Diversity:
• Diversity occurs when people of diverse backgrounds gather. An actual diverse society recognizes and values differences.
• UNESCO (2001 Declaration): Asserted that "cultural diversity is as necessary for humankind as biodiversity is for nature."
• Communities build trust, respect, and gain new ways of thinking, skills, and experiences through cultural exchange.

👉 የባህል ብዝሃነት (Diversity) ጥቅም፡
UNESCO እ.ኤ.አ በ2001 እንዳወጀው "የባህል ብዝሃነት ለሰው ልጅ ህልውና አስፈላጊነቱ፣ የተፈጥሮ ብዝሃነት (Biodiversity) ለተፈጥሮ አስፈላጊ እንደሆነው ሁሉ ነው":: ብዝሃነት በህብረተሰብ ውስጥ መከባበርን፣ አዲስ እውቀትን እና ጥንካሬን ይፈጥራል::


8. UNIT 5 SUMMARY & REVISION HIGHLIGHTS

• Ethnicity gained mainstream popularity in the late 20th century.
• Race vs. Ethnicity: Race is often mistakenly viewed as biological/phenotypical, but it is a social construct. Ethnicity is rooted in human social interaction and history.
• Primordialism: Ethnicity is fixed, biological, and unchangeable.
• Instrumentalism: Ethnicity is a tool manipulated by elites for political/economic gain.
• Constructivism: Ethnicity is dynamically constructed, deconstructed, and reconstructed in daily social life.
• Melting Pot vs. Salad Bowl: Melting Pot = Assimilation into one; Salad Bowl = Coexistence while keeping identity.

👉
ብሔረሰብነት በ20ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን መገባደጃ ላይ ትልቅ ትኩረት ያገኘ ፅንሰ-ሀሳብ ነው:: ዘር (Race) እና ብሔረሰብ (Ethnicity) ይለያያሉ፤ ዘር በአካላዊ ገጽታ ላይ ያተኮረ ማህበራዊ ግንባታ ሲሆን፣ ብሔረሰብነት ደግሞ በማህበራዊ ግንኙነትና ታሪክ ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው:: 3ቱ ቲዎሪዎች (Primordialism, Instrumentalism, Constructivism) እና 2ቱ የባህል ሞዴሎች (Melting Pot & Salad Bowl) ለፈተናችሁ ዋና ዋና ነጥቦች ናቸው!
